scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ternakin/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @ternakin/shared" "npm run dev -w @ternakin/api" "npm run dev -w @ternakin/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ternakin/shared && npm run build -w @ternakin/web && npm run build -w @ternakin/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ternakin/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ternakin/api && npm run typecheck -w @ternakin/web && npm run typecheck -w @ternakin/mobile
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ternakin/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.mobile: npm run build -w @ternakin/shared && npm run dev -w @ternakin/mobile
